nodes.label: Boundary Sharpness Curve
nodes.content: Line plot: Embedding Change Rate Around Phoneme Boundaries comparing Natural vs TTS speech. X-axis: time relative to boundary (-100ms to +100ms). Y-axis: Cosine Change Rate. Both curves show symmetric bell-shaped peak at phoneme boundary (0ms). Peak natural: 0.2118. Peak TTS: 0.2251. TTS shows slightly more abrupt/higher transition rate at boundaries, suggesting sharper but less smooth phoneme transitions than natural speech.

nodes.label: Phoneme Boundary Sharpness
nodes.content: Analysis of embedding change rate around phoneme boundaries comparing natural and TTS speech. Both show bell-shaped peak at boundary (0ms) with cosine change rate metric. TTS has slightly higher peak (0.2251 vs 0.2118 natural), indicating more abrupt but less smooth transitions in synthesized speech. Suggests TTS models exaggerate phoneme boundary transitions compared to natural speech coarticulation.
